The land in Gut No.42 belongs to the petitioner herein, out of which 300 sq. mtrs.
portion has been acquired for construction of a National Highway.
After compliance of the mandates of Section 3-H of the National Highways Act, 1956 an award was passed.
The private respondents herein raised objection claiming to have interest in the well which was affected by the acquisition.
Before that the petitioner had already been paid the amount of compensation.
